differences: The deposit's page cites Hausdorff et al. 1997 (young, elderly and Huntington's disease subjects) and Hausdorff et al. 1998, Mov Disord 13:428-437 (Parkinson's and Huntington's disease), but contains 5 young, 5 older and 5 Parkinson's disease recordings and no Huntington's disease; the 1997 paper's DFA exponents (young 0.87, elderly 0.68) are therefore not checked here, only the dataset description.

The page gives the young adults as 23-29 years; one young file name carries age 21. The page says PD participants walked 6 min and healthy participants 15 min; the series end at about 5 min and 14.5 min (heel-strike times), and begin 22-31 s in, so the deposit holds a trimmed part of each walk.
